anthropic.source: Anthropic prompt caching pricing: cache reads 0.1x the base input price, 5-minute cache writes 1.25x, 1-hour cache writes 2x

openai.source: OpenAI API pricing (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing): no separate cache-write price for these models; tokens written to the cache bill as input

[1m].source: Claude Code's [1m] model suffix names the 1M-token long-context variant, whatever window the base model's row gives

supplement.source: Anthropic API pricing, fast mode (research preview, Claude API only): Claude Opus 4.8 at $10 / $50 per million tokens
Anthropic API pricing, fast mode (research preview, Claude API only): Claude Opus 5 at $10 / $50 per million tokens
Anthropic API pricing, fast mode (research preview, Claude API only): Claude Opus 5.5 at $8 / $40 per million tokens, 2x standard
